dedupe_keys.name: modelling and set point definition for the development of a joint control system of two interconnected wastewater treatment plants and its application in practice

description: The registered abstract describes an ASM3 plus BioP model of a municipal wastewater plant, developed to test control scenarios jointly with an upstream industrial plant. A predictive total-nitrogen-load equation uses real-time upstream data, and model-derived aeration set-points inform a joint controller. The source states implementation in a real environment and an initial increase in nitrogen-removal energy efficiency, without giving a numerical effect in the abstract. The related measurement dataset is already catalogued separately. The native record declares CC BY 4.0 while Crossref identifies CC BY-NC 4.0 for the publication; this rights conflict is retained, and no source-code licence or public implementation is inferred. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
